description:
A thoughtful young adult woman with a warm, clear mid-range voice. Give her a light, conversational tone and quiet confidence. She sounds like a friend who listens closely, spots what everyone else missed, and asks the one question that makes it click.

Speak at a steady, moderately brisk pace with crisp articulation and natural pitch variation. Let genuine curiosity lift her questions slightly. When she makes an important point, give the key word a little emphasis and let the sentence settle. Let dry jokes land with a hint of a smile. Keep the performance grounded and expressive, with the intimacy of speaking to one person.

en.text: Leila had only one choice: cross the bridge before sunset. The winds were growing stronger, and the ground was trembling beneath her feet. But she refused to turn back.
